## Appearance

Carl possesses brown hair featuring glints of gold. He has clear, bright, dark-blue eyes that are described as fearless and direct. At one point, he is seen wearing Una's dress.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P11](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0011)_

## Personality

Fascinated by nature, this young boy possesses a unique affinity for insects and small creatures, often keeping a collection of toads, frogs, and bugs. Driven by a deep passion for ants, spiders, and wildlife, he harbors a strong desire to explore African jungles when he grows up. Despite his comfort with the natural world and his intimate understanding of bees and beetles, he finds himself deeply unsettled by ghost stories.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P34](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0034), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P8](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. ## History

Carl moves from [Maywater](../codex/places.md#maywater) to [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary with his motherless siblings and minister father, settling into the manse and quickly forming a close bond with the local [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). Along with his brothers and sisters, he takes in a runaway orphan named [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), hiding her in their garret until she is eventually adopted by Miss Cornelia. Later, while his father is away and his aunt is sick, Carl falls ill himself while his sisters struggle to manage the household. To prevent further trouble and protect their father's reputation, Carl and his siblings form a self-policing Good-[Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#conduct-club), through which they enforce strict rules and punishments on themselves. When the club's members decide to self-punish by holding a day-long fast, his sister [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) faints from hunger at church, prompting their father to realize he needs to pay closer attention to raising them. Sometime later, after Carl is frightened by a fake ghost, his brother [Jerry](../character/jerry.md) punishes his cowardice by ordering him to sit in the cold, rainy graveyard until midnight. This ordeal causes Carl to contract double pneumonia and face a grim fight for his life, though he ultimately recovers to the community's relief. Carl eventually incurs his father's wrath after pulling a prank with an eel on a local woman, though his father finds himself unable to whip him upon looking into his eyes. In the end, after [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) selflessly asks [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to marry their father, Carl's family prepares for his father's upcoming wedding while celebrating with their friends in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P2](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P3](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0003), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P4](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER II.
